quotes.speaker: Johni Broome
quotes.summary_phrase: Johni Broome on the intensity and culture set by Coach Doc Rivers
quotes.excerpt: Coach really sets the tone. He brings it every day, and he just expects us to bring it too.
quotes.quote: Camp's been good. I love the energy that I came into the building. Coach really sets the tone. He brings it every day, and he just expects us to bring it too. He's fiery, so I think everybody on the court brings that same grit, that same fire, and just play hard.
quotes.social_post: Johni Broome says Doc Rivers sets a fiery tone for the Bucks in camp. He says the coach expects everyone to bring the same grit and fire to the court every day.

quotes.speaker: Johni Broome
quotes.summary_phrase: Johni Broome on his personal development goals for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: Just being a smarter player, knowing when to attack, when to read the floor.
quotes.quote: Just being a smarter player, knowing when to attack, when to read the floor. Obviously working on my shot, knocking down the open shots, defending, being able to be a more versatile defender, and then just continually work on rebounding and closing possessions out.
quotes.social_post: Johni Broome is focused on becoming a smarter player and a more versatile defender this season. He says he is working on reading the floor and knocking down open shots.

quotes.speaker: Johni Broome
quotes.summary_phrase: Johni Broome on why he chose to join the Milwaukee Bucks
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I could fit into the team very well, and obviously Coach Doc Rivers.
quotes.quote: Just because of I feel like I could fit into the team very well, and obviously Coach Doc Rivers. That's a coach that I want to play for.
quotes.social_post: Johni Broome says the chance to play for Doc Rivers was a major factor in his decision to join the Milwaukee Bucks.

quotes.speaker: Johni Broome
quotes.summary_phrase: Johni Broome on the business-like reality of the NBA
quotes.excerpt: That it is a business, so nothing's personal.
quotes.quote: That it is a business, so nothing's personal. I'm just going to take advantage of the opportunity that I get and just kind of continue to work on myself and to keep building and be the best team I can be.
quotes.social_post: Johni Broome on the transition to the NBA. He says he understands it is a business and is focused on taking advantage of his opportunities.

quotes.speaker: Johni Broome
quotes.summary_phrase: Johni Broome on the team's commitment to hard work and physical conditioning
quotes.excerpt: We're going to be the most in shape team. We're going to bring it every single game.
quotes.quote: We know we have it in the building. Since I've been here, I think the motto has been putting in the work. We're going to be the most in shape team. We're going to bring it every single game, and we're going to work hard to achieve those goals. Ultimately our goal is to win games, so we're going to try to win as many games as possible.
quotes.social_post: Johni Broome says the Bucks are aiming to be the most in shape team in the league. He says the team motto is all about putting in the work to win as many games as possible.

quotes.speaker: Johni Broome
quotes.summary_phrase: Johni Broome on his relationship with Doc Rivers and his fit in Milwaukee
quotes.excerpt: He likes my IQ, my skill set, and he thinks I can fit into this team.
quotes.quote: I think he just likes me as a player. He likes my IQ, my skill set, and he thinks I can fit into this team, just like I think so as well. Everybody in the building, the goal is to win, and obviously I'm a winner as well, so I think that's the main goal and we're going to keep it at that.
quotes.social_post: Johni Broome says Doc Rivers values his IQ and skill set. He believes his game is a natural fit for the team goal of winning.

quotes.speaker: Johni Broome
quotes.summary_phrase: Johni Broome on prioritizing team success over individual statistics
quotes.excerpt: I don't really have any personal goals. All my goals are team goals this year.
quotes.quote: I don't really have any personal goals. All my goals are team goals this year, and that's just to win, make an impact on winning, whether I'm on the court or off the court, cheering my teammates on, just kind of being the best teammate I can be.
quotes.social_post: Johni Broome says he has no personal goals for this season. His only focus is to make an impact on winning whether he is on the court or cheering on his teammates.
